name: Gröbenhof
beschreibung:
Perched on a quiet, sunny hillside overlooking Fulpmes, Hotel Groebenhof features well-appointed rooms, a restorative spa area, and fine regional gastronomy. It is a wonderful mountain getaway.

The Schlick 2000 ski resort, the StuBay leisure center, and the Stubai Glacier are reachable in minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Groebenhof in Fulpmes delights guests with warm hospitality, spa wellness, and valley vistas in Stubai.
